walkthroughs.body_html:
When a transversal crosses two parallel lines, corresponding angles are equal.

Look for an F-shape — the matching corners are equal.

Alternate angles between parallel lines are equal.

Spot a Z-shape — the two angles on opposite sides of the transversal are equal.

Co-interior angles on the same side of a transversal sum to 180°.

If one is 110°, the other is 180 − 110 = 70°.

options: Equal
Supplementary
Complementary
Vertically opposite

mcqs.q: Two parallel lines are cut by a transversal. What is the relationship between co-interior (allied) angles?
options: They are equal to each other, like alternate angles.
They add up to 360 degrees because they make a full turn.
They add up to 180 degrees.
The object is moving backwards.
They add up to 360 degrees because they make a full turn.
2, because in BIDMAS multiplication comes before division (12 / 6).
7, because you do 12 / 2 = 6 and then add 3 with the multiplication symbol meaning 'and'.
18 — division and multiplication share the same precedence; work left to right (6 x 3).

mcqs.q: On a distance-time graph, what does a horizontal line mean?
options: The object is moving at a constant speed.
The object is moving backwards.
7, because you do 12 / 2 = 6 and then add 3 with the multiplication symbol meaning 'and'.
The object is stationary — distance is not changing, so speed is zero.
